# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We are committed to making participation in this project respectful, safe, and constructive for everyone.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and professional in all interactions.
- Assume good intent and focus on technical facts.
- Provide actionable feedback instead of personal criticism.
- Keep discussions relevant to the project goals.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory language.
- Personal attacks, intimidation, or doxxing.
- Spam, trolling, or intentionally disruptive behavior.
- Sharing sensitive data or private information without consent.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may edit, hide, or remove content that violates this code and may restrict participation when necessary.

## Reporting

If you observe behavior that violates this code, open a private security report or contact maintainers via repository security channel.
